config_discrepancy: Champion config_snapshot.yaml confirms early_stopping_monitor=val_accuracy, NOT val_macro_f1 as narrated in the Stage 5 handoff. Champion selection used manual MacroF1Evaluator in train.py (best_val_macro_f1 tracked separately). The Keras early-stopping monitor (val_accuracy) does not affect which weights were checkpointed — the manual macro-F1 counter controlled that. Discrepancy is informational; it does not invalidate the reported val_macro_f1=0.6011.

calibration.temperature_scaling_note: Temperature scaling (dividing pre-softmax logits by scalar T) is the standard post-hoc calibration remedy. Not implemented in Stage 6 because this module receives post-softmax probabilities. See LIMITATIONS.md.

val_test_gap.interpretation: Indirect val-set overfitting: champion hyperparameters (epoch budget, augmentation strategy, landmark config) were selected based on val performance. Test provides the unbiased estimate. Gap is expected and not evidence of leakage (splits are signer-aware with zero overlap).
